# Social Media Downloader & Converter

DL Anything You Want is a free, self-hostable English downloader and converter for permitted Facebook (FB), Instagram (IG), Threads, YouTube and TikTok media. Outputs MP4 video, MP3 audio and PNG images where available.

## Website

- English website: https://jacbus1.github.io/dl-anything-you-want/

## Source and author

- Source: https://github.com/jacbus1/dl-anything-you-want
- Author: JACKY H. (@jacbus1): https://github.com/jacbus1

The public GitHub Pages site is the frontend. Media extraction requires the separately running backend. Download only content you own or have permission to use.
